label: Lease
notes: Existing location: the lease is expiring, so follow up 6 months before it expires, then review the draft until it's approved.
New location: starts when the site approval form comes in. There's no lease on file yet, so there's no expiration date.
Link the case to any open renewal, transfer or expansion for the same premises so whoever is handling that case is in the loop (e.g. a transfer needs a lease assignment to the new tenant).

flags.label: New location
flags.hint: Existing: the lease is expiring and needs an extension, renewal or new lease. New: starts with a site approval form.

hints.text: Goes out 6 months before the lease expires.
The site approval form for the new location came in.

steps.label: Lease draft received
steps.hint: Keep following up until the franchisee sends the extension, renewal or new lease.

steps.label: Lease review
steps.hint: Review the draft and go back and forth with the franchisee until it's satisfactory. Add a note for each round so the history is clear.

expired_text: Lease expired {date} and the new one isn't approved yet
expiring_text: Lease expires {date} ({days} left) and the new one isn't approved yet
